answer_1.quote: We analyzed 14,301 English question-answer pairs from the HotpotQA test set under controlled conditions to investigate (1) the statistical modeling of LLM output word counts, and (2) the impact of anchored prompts and temperature on LLM response characteristics.

answer_2.quote: Model selection via maximum likelihood estimation used both Akaike information criterion (AIC) and root-mean-square error (RMSE).
